opponent.label: Edelgard
opponent.description: Princess and heir apparent of the Adrestian Empire, Edelgard attends the Officers Academy at Garreg Mach Monastery, where she leads the Black Eagles House. Outwardly the model of strict, dignified noble, her dilligent and aloof demeanor belies both a young woman shouldering immense burdens and an iconoclast with ambitions that will forever alter the course of history.
